_comment: News overlay applied on top of ESPN projections at board-build time. ESPN projects 17 games for EVERY player, so its numbers carry no injury discount and it knows nothing about season-enders. `mult` scales projected points; 0 removes the player from the board entirely. This is the highest-leverage manual input in the tool - a few minutes with an injury tracker before your draft is worth more than any tuning knob. Copy this file to news-overrides.json and put your own entries in it.

Example Player One.note: torn ACL in camp - out for the season, remove from the board

Example Player Two.note: hamstring; expected to miss the first 2-3 games

Example Player Three.note: the back ahead of him is hurt - clearer path to volume than ESPN assumes
